image_description: A white baby bib lying flat on a beige textured fabric surface. The bib features a terry cloth upper section and a cross-stitch style lower panel with the name 'LUCIA' embroidered in green thread. It has white binding around the edges and long white ties extending from the neck area.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object classification as a bib and distinguish it from similar apparel like aprons or napkins.
To verify the legibility and structural integrity of the embroidered text, a common failure point in AI generation.
To ensure the ties connect logically to the body and the binding forms a continuous, closed loop without melting.
To analyze the consistency of the terry cloth vs. woven textures and check for unnatural blending or noise.

focus_areas: Text rendering quality (spelling and stitch definition)
Texture consistency (terry cloth loops vs. smooth binding)
Structural connectivity of the neck ties
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the embroidery. In AI images, text often looks like gibberish or melts into the background. Verify if the green letters 'LUCIA' have distinct, logical stitch-like structures or if they are just blurry green blobs. Also, check if the terry cloth texture looks repetitive/tiled (a sign of AI generation) or naturally random.
